description: Use this ONLY when a business owner explicitly asks to talk to someone about a strategy call or a fixed-scope audit. Records name, email, company, and what they said they need, then creates a request for a human to follow up on. Do NOT use proactively, do NOT use as an upsell at the end of a free audit, and do NOT use it as a lead-capture step. There is no in-plugin purchase: the audit is a fixed-scope engagement booked directly, and this tool only records intent.

consentGranted.description: Must be true. Confirms the user agreed to be contacted about a strategy call.

email.description: The contact's email address, for a human to reply to.

need.description: What they said the system needs to do, in their own words. This is what scopes the audit.

note.description: Optional message. Do not include patient or client identifiers, medical history, matter numbers, or payment details — those are rejected and not stored.

name: growth.request_strategy_call
title: Request Strategy Call
